en: (neuter) (1) *nibbāna* (free from *vaṭṭa*). (2) the 9 *lokuttara* states (free from *vaṭṭa*). (3) *magga*, *phala* (free from *vaṭṭa*). See [[vivaṭṭasukha]] (2). (masculine) (4) the Buddha (free from *vaṭṭa*). (5) the *rahantā* (free from *vaṭṭa*). See [[vivaṭṭapakkha]].

es: *vivaṭṭakathā*; palabras en que se enseñan / que son causa de enseñar *magga*, *phala* y *nibbāna*, libres del *vaṭṭa*.
en: *vivaṭṭakathā*; words in which are taught / that are a cause of teaching *magga*, *phala* and *nibbāna*, free from *vaṭṭa*.

es: el eón *vivaṭṭa*; el eón que está surgiendo / creciendo.
en: the *vivaṭṭa* aeon; the aeon that is arising / growing.

es: que se da en los 9 estados *lokuttara* libres del *vaṭṭa*.
en: occurring in the 9 *lokuttara* states free from *vaṭṭa*.

en: the *kamma* apt to lead to *magga*, *phala* and *nibbāna*, free from *vaṭṭa*.

es: el *kamma* sano que suele llevar a *magga*, *phala* y *nibbāna*, libres del *vaṭṭa* (los 37 estados *bodhipakkhiya*).
en: the wholesome *kamma* apt to lead to *magga*, *phala* and *nibbāna*, free from *vaṭṭa* (the 37 *bodhipakkhiya* states).

es: los estados sanos que suelen llevar a *magga*, *phala* y *nibbāna*, libres del *vaṭṭa*.
en: the wholesome states apt to lead to *magga*, *phala* and *nibbāna*, free from *vaṭṭa*.

es: el enlazar con lo sano / el pasaje de enlace de lo sano que suele llevar a *magga*, *phala* y *nibbāna*, libres del *vaṭṭa*.
en: connecting with the wholesome / the connecting passage of the wholesome that is apt to lead to *magga*, *phala* and *nibbāna*, free from *vaṭṭa*.

es: el don de la Enseñanza que suele llevar a *magga*, *phala* y *nibbāna*.
en: the gift of the Teaching that is apt to lead to *magga*, *phala* and *nibbāna*.

es: (a) la felicidad que se da a causa del *kamma* sano que suele llevar a *magga*, *phala* y *nibbāna*, libres del *vaṭṭa*. (b) la felicidad que se da junto con el *kamma* sano que suele llevar a *magga*, *phala* y *nibbāna*.
en: (a) the happiness arising because of the wholesome *kamma* apt to lead to *magga*, *phala* and *nibbāna*, free from *vaṭṭa*. (b) the happiness arising together with the wholesome *kamma* apt to lead to *magga*, *phala* and *nibbāna*.

en: (the wholesome) apt to lead to / that is a cause of reaching *magga*, *phala* and *nibbāna*, free from *vaṭṭa*.

es: la palabra *vivaṭṭa*.
en: the word *vivaṭṭa*.

(2) (el Buddha) que suele librarse del techo (que comienza por el *rāga*) del que ha de librarse.
en: (1) (the Buddha) having the roof (beginning with *rāga*) opened / removed / abolished / demolished / destroyed; (the Buddha) who has opened / removed / abolished / demolished / destroyed the roof (beginning with *rāga*). (2) (the Buddha) apt to free himself from the roof (beginning with *rāga*) that is to be got rid of.

en: (the Buddha) free from the 3 *vaṭṭa* and the 7 roofs.

en: the accomplishment of the meaning of the word *vivaṭṭacchada* (the accomplishment of the state of being one whose roof is opened / removed / abolished / demolished).

en: having a wish by / in / for *magga*, *phala* and *nibbāna*, free from *vaṭṭa* (said of a person).

en: the *vivaṭṭaṭṭhāyī* aeon (the aeon apt to stand in the mode of growing beyond having grown). See [[vivaṭṭa]] (2).

es: (1) rueda / gira una y otra vez, de un lado a otro; se revuelca / rueda. (2) se desliza hacia abajo. (3) surge / crece. (4) se aparta / retrocede / queda libre. (5) permanece.
en: (1) rolls / turns over and over, back and forth; wallows / rolls. (2) slides down. (3) arises / grows. (4) moves away / retreats / becomes free. (5) stands.

es: se aparta / retrocede / queda libre. Véase también [[vivaṭṭati]].
en: moves away / retreats / becomes free. See also [[vivaṭṭati]].

es: que se apoya en los estados (*magga*, *phala*, *nibbāna*) libres del *vaṭṭa*.
en: depending on the states (*magga*, *phala*, *nibbāna*) free from *vaṭṭa*.

es: (1) el *ariyamagga*. (2) el surgir / crecer. (3) el apartarse / volverse / retroceder / quedar libre. Véase también [[vivaṭṭanaṭṭha]]. (4) el permanecer bien. (5) (el momento / tiempo) de deslizarse hacia abajo. Véase la entrada siguiente. (adjetivo) (6) que suele apartarse / volverse / retroceder / quedar libre.
en: (1) the *ariyamagga*. (2) arising / growing. (3) moving away / turning back / retreating / becoming free. See also [[vivaṭṭanaṭṭha]]. (4) standing well. (5) (the time / period) of sliding down. See the following headword. (adjective) (6) apt to move away / turn back / retreat / become free.

es: el momento / tiempo de deslizarse hacia abajo.
en: the time / period of sliding down.

es: el modo de apartarse / retroceder / quedar libre.
en: the mode of moving away / receding / being free.

en: the *vipassanā* knowledge that contemplates again and again, receding and moving away from the *saṅkhāra*.

en: the side / faction of *magga*, *phala*, *nibbāna*, which are free from *vaṭṭa*.

en: the obtaining of *magga*, *phala*, *nibbāna*, which are free from *vaṭṭa*.

en: the power (*iddhipāda*) that is the basis of *magga*, *phala*, *nibbāna*, which are free from *vaṭṭa*.

es: que suele moverse / andar / ir y venir en el *viveka* / el lugar apartado / tranquilo (dicho de una persona).
en: in the habit of moving about / wandering / going to and fro in *viveka* / the secluded / quiet place (said of a person).

es: que tiene *pītisukha* nacido del estar libre / apartado / tranquilo (*viveka*) (el *jhāna*).
en: having *pītisukha* born of being free / secluded / quiet (*viveka*) (the *jhāna*).

es: (1) (el *jhāna*) nacido del estar apartado / tranquilo (*viveka*). Véanse también [[viveka]] (1) (2) (3). (2) (el *jhāna*) que se da en el grupo de estados *jhānasampayutta* (*viveka*), apartado / sosegado. Véanse también [[viveka]] (1) (2) (3). (3) (el *jhāna*) que se da en el grupo de estados *jhānasampayutta* (*viveka*), hecho libre / apartado / aislado y separado. Véanse también [[viveka]] (1) (2) (3).
en: (1) (the *jhāna*) born of being secluded / quiet (*viveka*). See also [[viveka]] (1) (2) (3). (2) (the *jhāna*) that arises in the group of *jhānasampayutta* states (*viveka*), which is secluded / calmed. See also [[viveka]] (1) (2) (3). (3) (the *jhāna*) that arises in the group of *jhānasampayutta* states (*viveka*), made free / secluded / isolated and separate. See also [[viveka]] (1) (2) (3).

es: (neutro) (1) *pītisukha* nacido del estar apartado / tranquilo (*viveka*). (2) (el *jhāna*) que tiene *pītisukha* nacido del estar apartado / tranquilo (*viveka*). Véase [[vivekajaṁpītisukha]].
en: (neuter) (1) *pītisukha* born of being secluded / quiet (*viveka*). (2) (the *jhāna*) having *pītisukha* born of being secluded / quiet (*viveka*). See [[vivekajaṁpītisukha]].

en: (1) the wish / *chanda* that arises for being secluded / quiet (*viveka*). (adjective) (2) having wish / *chanda* for being secluded / quiet (*viveka*) (said of a person).

es: (1) (a) que está asentado en el *nibbāna* (donde se está libre de los *kilesa*). (b) (la mente del *arahant*) evitada por los *kilesa* / alejada de los *kilesa*. (2) (a) que está asentado en un lugar apartado (de seres y *saṅkhāra*). (b) (el *kāyaviveka*) muy alejado / apartado (de seres y *saṅkhāra*). (3) el estar apartado / alejado. Véase [[vivekaṭṭha]].
en: (1) (a) established in *nibbāna* (where one is free from the *kilesa*). (b) (the mind of the *arahant*) shunned by the *kilesa* / far from the *kilesa*. (2) (a) established in a place secluded (from beings and *saṅkhāra*). (b) (*kāyaviveka*) very far / remote (from beings and *saṅkhāra*). (3) being secluded / remote. See [[vivekaṭṭha]].

es: que depende del / se apoya en el *viveka* — (1) que depende del / se apoya en el *nibbāna*, donde se está apartado / tranquilo. (2) que depende de / se apoya en los 3 apartamientos (llamados *tadaṅga*, *samuccheda*, *nissaraṇa*). (3) que depende de / se apoya en los 5 apartamientos llamados *tadaṅga*, *vikkhambhana*, *samuccheda*, *paṭippassaddhi*, *nissaraṇa*.
en: relying on / resting on *viveka* — (1) relying on / resting on *nibbāna*, where one is secluded / quiet. (2) relying on / resting on the 3 seclusions (namely *tadaṅga*, *samuccheda*, *nissaraṇa*). (3) relying on / resting on the 5 seclusions namely *tadaṅga*, *vikkhambhana*, *samuccheda*, *paṭippassaddhi*, *nissaraṇa*.
